about.body: The Td5 is Land Rover's 2.5-litre inline-five diesel engine, produced from 1998 to 2006. It was the first common-rail diesel engine fitted to Land Rover models, powering the Defender (L316) from 1999 and the Discovery 2 (L318) from 1998. The Td5 is a chain-driven engine, using a timing chain rather than a belt, and was replaced by Ford-sourced diesel engines in later models.

byModel.body: The Td5 is found in two core Land Rover model lines. In the Defender (L316), it was fitted from 1999 to 2006. In the Discovery 2 (L318), it was fitted from 1998 to 2004. These are the only applications we work on for this engine.

compatibility.body: Because the Td5 spans two different model lines and multiple production years, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and spec. A Td5 from a Defender isn't a drop-in match for a Td5 from a Discovery 2, even though it's the same base engine code — ancillaries, mounting, and ECU software all differ. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
compatibility.boldNote: We always confirm by registration/VIN before any rebuild or replacement.
